A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the baryonic B meson decays are very important in the study of b→s transitions.
the penguin-induced radiate baryonic B meson decays are promising to be observed in the B factories.
the baryonic B meson decays B→ΛΛ and B→ΛΞ are not only the most important bottom baryon decays but also the only two-body B decays with the largest rates.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the baryonic B radiative decay B − →Λ¯pγ is a promising mode for measuring the CKM matrix element |Vub| in the future.
the b→sγ process can be probed in baryonic B modes, which can be used as a tool to test the penguin transition and its short-distance contribution.
the penguin-induced baryonic B meson decays B→B1B2γ are more copious than the two-body B decays B → B 1 B2.
